module Workloads exposing (..)

import Primitive exposing (..)
import Builtin exposing (..)
import Literal exposing (..)
import Logic exposing (..)

sum : list int -> int
sum xs =
    case xs of
        [] -> 0
        x :: rest -> Builtin.addInteger x (sum rest)

listTraversal : int
listTraversal = sum [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]

countdown : int -> int -> int
countdown n result =
    if Builtin.equalsInteger n 0 then
        result
    else
        countdown (Builtin.subtractInteger n 1) result

staticRecursion : int
staticRecursion = countdown 8 42

matchData : Data -> int
matchData value =
    case value of
        I n -> n
        _ -> 0

dataMatch : int
dataMatch = matchData (I 42)

dataMiss : int
dataMiss = matchData (B #"ab")

decode : Data -> int
decode value =
    case value of
        Constr pair(_, [I n, _]) -> n
        _ -> 0

decoding : int
decoding = decode (Builtin.constrData 0 [I 42, I 7])

validate : Data -> unit
validate value =
    case value of
        I n -> assert (Builtin.lessThanInteger 0 n)
        _ -> fail

validationPass : unit
validationPass = validate (I 42)

validationFail : unit
validationFail = validate (I 0)

booleanHelpers : bool
booleanHelpers = (True && False) || (True && True)

constantPrefixTwice : int
constantPrefixTwice =
    Builtin.addInteger (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 1) (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 2)

constantPrefixCold : int
constantPrefixCold =
    if True then
        42
    else
        Builtin.addInteger (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 1) (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 2)

prefixLoop : int -> int
prefixLoop n =
    if Builtin.equalsInteger n 0 then
        0
    else
        Builtin.addInteger
            (Builtin.addInteger (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 n) (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 n))
            (prefixLoop (Builtin.subtractInteger n 1))

constantPrefixLoop : int
constantPrefixLoop = prefixLoop 8

unusedSelf : int -> int -> int
unusedSelf unused n =
    if Builtin.equalsInteger n 0 then
        42
    else
        unusedSelf unused (Builtin.subtractInteger n 1)

recursiveUnusedSelf : int
recursiveUnusedSelf = unusedSelf (Builtin.trace "entry" 7) 3

unusedFirst : int -> int -> int
unusedFirst unused n =
    if Builtin.equalsInteger n 0 then
        42
    else
        unusedSecond (Builtin.subtractInteger n 1) unused

unusedSecond : int -> int -> int
unusedSecond n unused = unusedFirst unused n

recursiveUnusedMutual : int
recursiveUnusedMutual = unusedFirst (Builtin.trace "entry" 7) 3
